newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-SRI LANKA 220-6 VS NEW ZEALAND AT TEA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA 220-6 VS NEW ZEALAND AT TEA.

text.p: Sri Lanka were 220 for six in their second innings, still needing 144 to make New Zealand bat again, at tea on the fourth day of the first cricket test on Monday.
New Zealand scored 586 in their first innings and enforced the follow-on after Sri Lanka were all out for 222 in reply.
New Zealand first innings 586 for seven declared (B. Young 267 not out).
Sri Lanka first innings 222 (S. Doull 5-58). Second innings 220 for six (S. Jayasuriya 50).
